newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodian premier Ranariddh says Pol Pot not found.
newsitem.headline: Cambodian premier Ranariddh says Pol Pot not found.

text.p: Cambodia's First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh said on Thursday Khmer Rouge guerrilla strongman Pol Pot had not been found, contradicting a rebel splinter group's radio report saying he had surrendered.
Ranariddh told reporters most of Pol Pot's supporters had deserted him and were now trying to capture him and bring him to justice, so far without success.
"Pol Pot has not been found," Ranariddh said.
The prince said all but between five and 10 of Pol Pot's supporters had deserted him and his former comrades were now hunting him down.
"The other side is not only ready to cut themselves from Pol Pot but to try to capture Pol Pot and send him to an international court," he said.
A radio broadcast, apparently made by Pol Pot's former comrades-in-arms on Wednesday, said the reviled leader of the 1975-79 "killing fields" regime had turned himself in to them to "confess".
